meta.name: Coast to Kosciuszko Ultramarathon (Cow Bail Trail Route)

pois.name: Start at Boydtown Beach
pois.description: Race starts at 05:30 on Friday

pois.name: Nullica River Bridge
pois.description: Keep to the right of the safety barrier to cross Nullica River Bridge via the footpath

pois.name: Pacific Hwy Crossing
pois.description: Cross the highway here after the bridge

pois.name: Aid Station
pois.description: At Nullica Rd junction

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #1 - Towamba
pois.description: Landmark: use building on right hand side when arriving into Towamba

pois.name: Runner / Crew Rendezvous Point
pois.description: Support crews wait for runners here - enjoy breakfast here courtesy of Towamba Public School 😊

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #2 - Rocky Hall
pois.description: Landmark: Rocky Hall Public Telephone on left hand side of road

pois.name: Cow Bail Trail
pois.description: Only runners and pacers are allowed beyond this point - support crew must u-turn and proceed to Cathcart via New Buildings Rd and Mount Darragh Rd where they can meet up with their runner at Cathcart General Store

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #3 - Cathcart
pois.description: Landmark: Cathcart General Store

pois.name: Monaro Hwy Entry
pois.description: Run on right hand side of road facing oncoming traffic

pois.name: Monaro Highway Crossing & Exit
pois.description: Cross Monaro Highway here

pois.name: Cattle Grid Crossings
pois.description: There will be numerous cattle grids situated on next 20 km of route – please take care

pois.name: Cross Disused Railway Line
pois.description: Cattle grid crossing on other side

pois.name: Big Dead Tree
pois.description: On right hand side on uphill section

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #4 - Gunningrah Rd & Snowy River Way
pois.description: Landmark: a disused livestock ramp is visible at the intersection

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #5 - Dalgety
pois.description: Landmark: Dalgety Memorial Hall

pois.name: Cut-Off Point #1
pois.description: Landmark: beyond Dalgety bridge at 06:30 on Saturday - 25hrs since start

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #6 - Jindabyne
pois.description: Landmark: Jindabyne Caravan Park Office

pois.name: Cut-Off Point #2
pois.description: Landmark: just beyond Jindabyne Caravan Park Office at 14:00 on Saturday - 32:30hrs since start

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #7 - Perisher Valley
pois.description: Landmark: Perisher Village in bus shelter located right hand side of road, in front of Ski Tube Station

pois.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #8 - Charlotte Pass
pois.description: Landmark: Officials on the right-hand side at the wall

pois.name: Cut-Off Point #3
pois.description: Landmark: Charlotte Pass at 23:00 on Saturday - 41:30hrs since start

pois.name: Summit of Mt Kosciuszko
pois.description: Australia's highest point at 2,228m

pois.name: Finishing Line
pois.description: Cut off is at 03:30 on Sunday - 46hrs after start

cues.notes: Turn right onto Brandy Creek Trail
Turn right to stay on Towamba Rd
Turn left to stay on Towamba St
Continue onto Big Jack Mountain Rd
Turn left onto Cow Bail Trail
Turn right onto Cow Bail Ft/​Cow Bail Trail
Turn right onto Coolangubra Forest Way
Turn right onto Black Lake Rd
Turn left to stay on Black Lake Rd
Turn left onto Bukalong Siding Rd
Turn left onto The Snowy River Way
Turn right onto The Snowy River Way
At the roundabout, take the 3rd exit
Turn right to stay on Summit Walk
Slight left to stay on Summit Walk
Turn left to stay on Summit Walk
Summit Walk turns slightly left and becomes Kosciuszko Rd
